versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח קֹ֔רַח בֶּן־יִצְהָ֥ר בֶּן־קְהָ֖ת בֶּן־לֵוִ֑י וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם בְּנֵ֧י אֱלִיאָ֛ב וְא֥וֹן בֶּן־פֶּ֖לֶת בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵֽן׃

controles.web: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
controles.kjv: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
controles.livre: E Coré, filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi; e Datã e Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; e Om, filho de Pelete, dos filhos de Rúben, tomaram gente,

versos.hebraico: וַיָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים מִבְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם נְשִׂיאֵ֥י עֵדָ֛ה קְרִאֵ֥י מוֹעֵ֖ד אַנְשֵׁי־שֵֽׁם׃

controles.web: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
controles.kjv: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
controles.livre: E levantaram-se contra Moisés com duzentos e cinquenta homens dos filhos de Israel, príncipes da congregação, dos do conselho, homens de renome;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶם֮ רַב־לָכֶם֒ כִּ֤י כָל־הָֽעֵדָה֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים וּבְתוֹכָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה וּמַדּ֥וּעַ תִּֽתְנַשְּׂא֖וּ עַל־קְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”
controles.kjv: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?
controles.livre: E se juntaram contra Moisés e Arão, e lhes disseram: Basta-vos, porque toda a congregação, todos eles são santos, e em meio deles está o SENHOR: por que, pois, vos levantais vós sobre a congregação do SENHOR?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עַל־פָּנָֽיו׃

controles.web: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
controles.kjv: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
controles.livre: E quando o ouviu Moisés, lançou-se sobre seu rosto;

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־קֹ֜רַח וְאֶֽל־כָּל־עֲדָתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בֹּ֠קֶר וְיֹדַ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ וְאֶת־הַקָּד֖וֹשׁ וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֵלָ֑יו וְאֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַר־בּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֥יב אֵלָֽיו׃

controles.web: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
controles.kjv: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
controles.livre: E falou a Coré e a todo o seu grupo, dizendo: Amanhã mostrará o SENHOR quem é seu, e ao santo o fará chegar a si; e ao que ele escolher, ele o achegará a si.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֖את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ־לָכֶ֣ם מַחְתּ֔וֹת קֹ֖רַח וְכָל־עֲדָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;
controles.kjv: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
controles.livre: Fazei isto: tomai incensários, Coré e todo o seu grupo:

versos.hebraico: וּתְנ֣וּ בָהֵ֣ן׀ אֵ֡שׁ וְשִׂימוּ֩ עֲלֵיהֶ֨ן קְטֹ֜רֶת לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ מָחָ֔ר וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הַקָּד֑וֹשׁ רַב־לָכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃

controles.web: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
controles.kjv: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
controles.livre: E ponde fogo neles, e ponde neles incenso diante do SENHOR amanhã; e será que o homem a quem o SENHOR escolher, aquele será o santo: basta-vos isto, filhos de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־קֹ֑רַח שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃

controles.web: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
controles.livre: Disse mais Moisés a Coré: Ouvi agora, filhos de Levi:

versos.hebraico: הַמְעַ֣ט מִכֶּ֗ם כִּֽי־הִבְדִּיל֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵעֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַקְרִ֥יב אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑יו לַעֲבֹ֗ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲמֹ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתָֽם׃

controles.web: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
controles.kjv: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
controles.livre: Vos é pouco que o Deus de Israel vos haja apartado da congregação de Israel, fazendo-vos achegar a si para que ministrasses no serviço do tabernáculo do SENHOR, e estivésseis diante da congregação para ministrar-lhes?

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְאֶת־כָּל־אַחֶ֥יךָ בְנֵי־לֵוִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֖ם גַּם־כְּהֻנָּֽה׃

controles.web: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
controles.kjv: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
controles.livre: E que te fez aproximar a ti, e a todos os teus irmãos os filhos de Levi contigo; para que procureis também o sacerdócio?

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־עֲדָ֣תְךָ֔ הַנֹּעָדִ֖ים עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן מַה־ה֔וּא כִּ֥י תלונו עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you murmur against him?”
controles.kjv: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
controles.livre: Portanto, tu e todo o teu grupo sois os que vos juntais contra o SENHOR: pois Arão, que é para que contra ele murmureis?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִקְרֹ֛א לְדָתָ֥ן וְלַאֲבִירָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה׃

controles.web: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
controles.kjv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
controles.livre: E enviou Moisés a chamar a Datã e Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; mas eles responderam: Não iremos lá:

versos.hebraico: הַמְעַ֗ט כִּ֤י הֶֽעֱלִיתָ֨נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ לַהֲמִיתֵ֖נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי־תִשְׂתָּרֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖ינוּ גַּם־הִשְׂתָּרֵֽר׃

controles.web: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
controles.kjv: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
controles.livre: É pouco que nos tenhas feito vir de uma terra que destila leite e mel, para fazer-nos morrer no deserto, mas que também te faças senhor de nós autoritariamente?

versos.hebraico: אַ֡ף לֹ֣א אֶל־אֶרֶץ֩ זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֤ב וּדְבַשׁ֙ הֲבִ֣יאֹתָ֔נוּ וַתִּ֨תֶּן־לָ֔נוּ נַחֲלַ֖ת שָׂדֶ֣ה וָכָ֑רֶם הַעֵינֵ֞י הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָהֵ֛ם תְּנַקֵּ֖ר לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה׃

controles.web: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
controles.kjv: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
controles.livre: Nem tampouco nos puseste tu em terra que flua leite e mel, nem nos deste propriedades de terras e vinhas: hás de arrancar os olhos destes homens? Não subiremos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֤חַר לְמֹשֶׁה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה אַל־תֵּ֖פֶן אֶל־מִנְחָתָ֑ם לֹ֠א חֲמ֨וֹר אֶחָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ נָשָׂ֔אתִי וְלֹ֥א הֲרֵעֹ֖תִי אֶת־אַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
controles.kjv: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
controles.livre: Então Moisés se irou em grande maneira, e disse ao SENHOR: Não olhes a sua oferta: nem ainda um asno tomei deles, nem a nenhum deles fiz mal.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־קֹ֔רַח אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־עֲדָ֣תְךָ֔ הֱי֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֥ה וָהֵ֛ם וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן מָחָֽר׃

controles.web: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
controles.livre: Depois disse Moisés a Coré: Tu e todo o teu grupo, ponde-vos amanhã diante do SENHOR; tu, e eles, e Arão:

versos.hebraico: וּקְח֣וּ׀ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֞ם לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֔וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתַ֖יִם מַחְתֹּ֑ת וְאַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן אִ֥ישׁ מַחְתָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”
controles.kjv: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
controles.livre: E tomai cada um seu incensário, e ponde incenso neles, e achegai diante do SENHOR cada um seu incensário: duzentos e cinquenta incensários: tu também, e Arão, cada um com seu incensário.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְח֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔שׁ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם קְטֹ֑רֶת וַֽיַּעַמְד֗וּ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

controles.web: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
controles.kjv: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
controles.livre: E tomaram cada um seu incensário, e puseram neles fogo, e lançaram neles incenso, e puseram-se à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho com Moisés e Arão.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְהֵ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם קֹ֨רַח֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־כָּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting.   Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.
controles.kjv: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the congregation.
controles.livre: Já Coré havia feito juntar contra eles toda a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho: então a glória do SENHOR apareceu a toda a congregação.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הִבָּ֣דְל֔וּ מִתּ֖וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את וַאַכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כְּרָֽגַע׃

controles.web: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
controles.kjv: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
controles.livre: Apartai-vos dentre esta congregação, e os consumirei em um momento.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְּל֤וּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֕ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר הָאִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ יֶחֱטָ֔א וְעַ֥ל כָּל־הָעֵדָ֖ה תִּקְצֹֽף׃פ

controles.web: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
controles.kjv: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
controles.livre: E eles se lançaram sobre seus rostos, e disseram: Deus, Deus dos espíritos de toda carne, não é um homem o que pecou? E te irarás tu contra toda a congregação?

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵֽעָלוּ֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב לְמִשְׁכַּן־קֹ֖רַח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָֽם׃

controles.web: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
controles.kjv: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
controles.livre: Fala à congregação, dizendo: Apartai-vos de em derredor da tenda de Coré, Datã, e Abirão.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־דָּתָ֣ן וַאֲבִירָ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרָ֖יו זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
controles.kjv: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
controles.livre: E Moisés se levantou, e foi a Datã e Abirão; e os anciãos de Israel foram atrás dele.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־הָעֵדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר ס֣וּרוּ נָ֡א מֵעַל֩ אָהֳלֵ֨י הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָֽרְשָׁעִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאַֽל־תִּגְּע֖וּ בְּכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם פֶּן־תִּסָּפ֖וּ בְּכָל־חַטֹּאתָֽם׃

controles.web: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
controles.kjv: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
controles.livre: E ele falou à congregação, dizendo: Apartai-vos agora das tendas destes ímpios homens, e não toqueis nenhuma coisa sua, porque não pereçais em todos os seus pecados.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּעָל֗וּ מֵעַ֧ל מִשְׁכַּן־קֹ֛רֶח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם יָצְא֣וּ נִצָּבִ֗ים פֶּ֚תַח אָֽהֳלֵיהֶ֔ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם וְטַפָּֽם׃

controles.web: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
controles.kjv: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
controles.livre: E apartaram-se das tendas de Coré, de Datã, e de Abirão em derredor: e Datã e Abirão saíram e puseram-se às portas de suas tendas, com suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas crianças.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּֽי־יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֔נִי לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־לֹ֖א מִלִּבִּֽי׃

controles.web: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
controles.kjv: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
controles.livre: E disse Moisés: Em isto conhecereis que o SENHOR me enviou para que fizesse todas estas coisas: que não de meu coração as fiz.

versos.hebraico: אִם־כְּמ֤וֹת כָּל־הָֽאָדָם֙ יְמֻת֣וּן אֵ֔לֶּה וּפְקֻדַּת֙ כָּל־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם יִפָּקֵ֖ד עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃

controles.web: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.
controles.kjv: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.
controles.livre: Se como morrem todos os homens morrerem estes, ou se forem eles visitados à maneira de todos os homens, o SENHOR não me enviou.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־בְּרִיאָ֞ה יִבְרָ֣א יְהוָ֗ה וּפָצְתָ֨ה הָאֲדָמָ֤ה אֶת־פִּ֨יהָ֙ וּבָלְעָ֤ה אֹתָם֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֔ם וְיָרְד֥וּ חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י נִֽאֲצ֛וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up, with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.
controles.livre: Mas se o SENHOR fizer uma nova coisa, e a terra abrir sua boca, e os tragar com todas suas coisas, e descerem vivos ao mundo dos mortos, então conhecereis que estes homens irritaram ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ כְּכַלֹּת֔וֹ לְדַבֵּ֕ר אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַתִּבָּקַ֥ע הָאֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: As he made an end of speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que em acabando ele de falar todas estas palavras, rompeu-se a terra que estava debaixo deles:

versos.hebraico: וַתִּפְתַּ֤ח הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת־פִּ֔יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־בָּתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־הָאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְקֹ֔רַח וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־הָרֲכֽוּשׁ׃

controles.web: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
controles.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
controles.livre: E abriu a terra sua boca, e tragou-os a eles, e a suas casas, e a todos os homens de Coré, e a todos os seus pertences.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֨רְד֜וּ הֵ֣ם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָהֶ֛ם חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָה וַתְּכַ֤ס עֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאבְד֖וּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הַקָּהָֽל׃

controles.web: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol.  The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
controles.kjv: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
controles.livre: E eles, com tudo o que tinham, desceram vivos ao mundo dos mortos, e cobriu-os a terra, e pereceram do meio da congregação.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם נָ֣סוּ לְקֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָֽמְר֔וּ פֶּן־תִּבְלָעֵ֖נוּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
controles.kjv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
controles.livre: E todo Israel, os que estavam em derredor deles, fugiram ao grito deles; porque diziam: Não nos trague também a terra.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥שׁ יָצְאָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַתֹּ֗אכַל אֵ֣ת הַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מַקְרִיבֵ֖י הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃פ

controles.web: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
controles.kjv: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
controles.livre: E saiu fogo do SENHOR, e consumiu os duzentos e cinquenta homens que ofereciam o incenso.
